newsitem.title: TAIWAN: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 5.
newsitem.headline: PRESS DIGEST - Taiwan newspapers - November 5.

text.p: These are the leading stories in the Taiwan press on Tuesday. Reuter has not verified these stories and does not vouch for their accuracy.
CHINA TIMES - Detained video games tycoon Chou Jen-sheng says he has paid two legislators huge amounts of money. Investigators look into lawmakers' financial books.
Prosecutors start questioning all Yunlin county assembly members after assembly slashed all county government's budget for illegal building demolition.
UNITED DAILY NEWS - Cabinet approves finance ministry's proposal on tax reforms.
Chungli Farmers' Credit Association reopens for operations after being closed for more than one year over financial difficulties.
COMMERCIAL TIMES - President Lee Teng-hui says government will complete its privatisation programme.
Exports to Europe rise 9.5 percent in first three quarters of 1996 from year earlier.
ECONOMIC DAILY NEWS - Cabinet agrees to allow foreign-registered ships to dock at both Taiwan and China ports, a practice that has been banned.
